outcomes.description: A lesson states arithmetic that does not hold.
A question explanation mixes up two families of units.

newFindings.detail: 1 GB = 1024 MB -> The two sides do not match. 1 GB is 1,000,000,000 bytes and 1024 MB is 1,024,000,000 bytes. Decimal units step by 1000 and binary units (KiB, MiB, GiB) step by 1024.
